The H towers, suspension arrangement and twin roads match the inspected VisitKorea picture. The complete crossing and open central slot remain visible; fine inspection hardware is simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all18 shared-viewer images, including north-up mapped placement. Three canonical concrete, stainless and painted-metal graphs reuse the shared library without embedded images. mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all34 final browser light/LOD images. Skyline retains the whole silhouette with merged deck/end supports and two-sided suspension ribbons. District restores the twin decks and wind slot; street and closeup add cylindrical cables, with paired hangers, bands and sockets at close range. Tower feet and both unequal anchorages remain intact. Distant large-water-plane aliasing in a few far views is a recorded preview limitation.

geographicReview.notes: One inspected VisitKorea picture confirms the tall inclined H towers, suspension line, narrow twin roadway and shoreline context. Standard viewer PMTiles paired bridge roads and bay agree with the retained near-north/south foundation-centred frame. Retain2260m suspended deck,1545m central span and2545m cable anchorage spacing; longer3794.742m map approach extent is separate. Source sea-level0m agrees with coarse mapped bay samples. Deck height/vertical curve, foundation pads, tides and terminal joins remain approximate; adjoining mainland/Myodo approach roads are supplied by the viewer and are outside this model.
